recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If SupplyRequest subject/search/compartment behavior needs further work, handle it in the OO incubator workflow, likely through FHIR-52991 or a successor issue.
issue_request: FHIR-17677 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested a subject search parameter over SupplyRequest.deliverTo plus inclusion of that patient-linked search in the Patient compartment.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to commit 98752dd6c14e0ad544430fd0d7457f25282173d0, which changed the SupplyRequest Patient compartment entry from requester to subject and updated the then-active SupplyRequest spreadsheet. The remaining SupplyRequest search-parameter bundle still defines SearchParameter/SupplyRequest-subject with expression SupplyRequest.deliverTo.
additional_context: The current core build configuration no longer registers SupplyRequest as an active resource. Commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed SupplyRequest from source/fhir.ini and removed its compartment row, and current ballot/history narrative links SupplyRequest to the HL7 OO incubator IG. FHIR-52991 is a later Triaged OO incubator issue about broader SupplyRequest/SupplyDelivery subject, search, and compartment behavior, but it is unresolved and not a current core-build decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit and made no core source change. Editing inactive source/supplyrequest artifacts or re-adding a SupplyRequest row to the core compartment spreadsheet would not affect the current core build and would conflict with the later migration to OO incubator.
